quest.title: Heizou Talks Fraud
quest.description: Heizou plans to hold an anti-fraud campaign called "Heizou Talks Fraud." First of all, you two need to look for some actors...

chapter.num: Hangout Event: Shikanoin Heizou - Act I
chapter.title: Trap 'Em by Storm

talks.objective: Go to the Grand Narukami Shrine

dialogues.speaker: Etsu
dialogues.text: I apologize for earlier, I don't know what came over me.

dialogues.speaker: Etsu
dialogues.text: Oh, Detective Heizou? He can't stand people like me, I'm sure of it.

dialogues.speaker: Etsu
dialogues.text: Although he sounds polite and friendly, I can tell that he treats inmates convicted of fraud differently... He's really got something against us.

dialogues.speaker: Etsu
dialogues.text: Do you think he may have been defrauded himself before? Impossible, who could ever be cunning enough to fool Detective Heizou like that, hmm?

talks.objective: Look for the next performer in the city

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Hello there, Traveler. I must apologize for my cousin — he must have been causing you all kinds of trouble? He's always been quite a handful... but I promise he doesn't mean any harm.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: If he goes too far, please by all means put him in his place. And if he dares protest, just tell him he either does as he's told or he'll have me to answer to.

dialogues.speaker: Iba
dialogues.text: Getting on the wrong side of Heizou really was a mistake...

dialogues.speaker: Iba
dialogues.text: Eh? You two want to know what happened? There's not much to it, really.

dialogues.speaker: Iba
dialogues.text: As soon as I heard that Heizou was on the case, I knew it was over. I took the easy way out and confessed to everything. After all, what else can you do when a "Cyclone" is heading your way?

dialogues.speaker: Iba
dialogues.text: Heizou's nickname. It's what all the prisoners call him, haven't you heard it before?

dialogues.speaker: Iba
dialogues.text: There's nowhere to run, nowhere to hide... For criminals, Heizou is a force of nature nobody can contend with.
